content.text: The ophthalmology community gathered for an exhilarating display of surgical skill at the 3rd EyeSurg Tournament. It was hosted by CIME and the Department of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences in partnership with the Ophthalmology Society of Pakistan, as part of the 43rd KAROPHTH Annual Congress of Ophthalmology.

The EyeSurg Tournament showcases the skills and expertise of aspiring ophthalmologists and residents. It serves as a platform for knowledge exchange, healthy competition, and the exploration of cutting-edge advancements in ophthalmic surgery.

This year's tournament featured a series of challenging surgical scenarios that participants tackled with precision and skill. Among 80 residents, 21 were selected for the competition from across Karachi and Hyderabad.

Dr. Adnan Abdul Majeed from the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences (SIOVS) emerged victorious in this year tournament, marking a triumphant return after his previous participation in the 2nd EyeSurg. His dedication and enhanced expertise truly shone in this year's tournament.

As the 3rd EyeSurg Tournament unfolded at AKU, it reinforced the institution's role as a hub for healthcare education and innovation. It showcased the dedication of health professionals to raise the standards of eye care in Pakistan and beyond. With such collaborative efforts, the future of ophthalmic surgery in the region looks brighter than ever, promising better outcomes for patients and continued advancements in eye care.
